"""Measured Day 2 diagnostics and a separate direct-MuJoCo safety execution."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import mujoco

from core.simulation import sha256
from robot.controller import BRAKING_THRESHOLD_M, faulty_braking_controller
from core.bodybase import BodyBase
from core.worldbase import WorldBase


def stopping_prediction(mass_kg: float, braking_force_n: float, velocity_mps: float,
                        available_distance_m: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    values = (mass_kg, braking_force_n, velocity_mps, available_distance_m)
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in values) or mass_kg <= 0 or braking_force_n <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Prediction requires finite values and positive mass/force")
    acceleration = braking_force_n / mass_kg
    distance = velocity_mps**2 / (2 * acceleration)
    return {"kind": "analytical_prediction_not_simulator_measurement",
            "assumptions": "Constant maximum braking, no contact or opposing force, continuous time",
            "max_deceleration_mps2": acceleration, "stopping_distance_m": distance,
            "available_distance_m": available_distance_m, "distance_shortfall_m": distance - available_distance_m,
            "stop_before_wall_predicted": distance < available_distance_m,
            "predicted_wall_surface_speed_mps": math.sqrt(max(0, velocity_mps**2 - 2 * acceleration * max(0, available_distance_m)))}


def physical_parameters(model: mujoco.MjModel) -> dict[str, Any]:
    motor = model.actuator("x_motor").id
    if model.actuator_gear[motor, 0] != 1:
        raise ValueError("This experiment requires the established direct motor with gear=1")
    minimum_command = max(float(model.actuator_ctrlrange[motor, 0]),
                          float(model.actuator_forcerange[motor, 0]))
    return {"mass_kg": float(model.body("carriage").mass[0]),
            "max_braking_force_n": -minimum_command, "gear": float(model.actuator_gear[motor, 0]),
            "ctrlrange": model.actuator_ctrlrange[motor].tolist(),
            "scalar_forcerange_n": model.actuator_forcerange[motor].tolist(),
            "gravity_mps2": model.opt.gravity.tolist(),
            "contact_solref": model.geom("wall").solref.tolist()}


def evaluate_safety(samples: list[dict[str, Any]], world: WorldBase,
                    wall_geom_id: int, tolerance: float = 1e-12) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Strict Day 3 acceptance from measured states and actual contact identities."""
    if not samples:
        raise ValueError("Safety evaluation requires measured samples")
    contact_states = [any(wall_geom_id in c["geom_ids"] for c in s["contacts"]) for s in samples]
    events = sum(contact and (i == 0 or not contact_states[i - 1]) for i, contact in enumerate(contact_states))
    minimum = min(s["wall_clearance"] for s in samples)
    speed, end = abs(samples[-1]["velocity"]), samples[-1]["time"]
    finite = all(math.isfinite(s[f]) for s in samples for f in ("time", "velocity", "wall_clearance"))
    completed = (len(samples) == round(world.simulation_duration_s / world.simulation_timestep_s) + 1
                 and math.isclose(end, world.simulation_duration_s, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=tolerance))
    checks = {"zero_wall_collision_events": events == 0,
              "minimum_clearance": minimum >= world.minimum_clearance_m - tolerance,
              "final_speed": speed < world.max_final_speed_ms,
              "completion_within_deadline": completed and end <= world.completion_deadline_s + tolerance,
              "finite_measurements": finite}
    explanations = {
        "zero_wall_collision_events": f"Observed {events} wall contact episode(s) in {sum(contact_states)} sampled states",
        "minimum_clearance": f"Minimum clearance {minimum:.12g} m is below required {world.minimum_clearance_m:.12g} m",
        "final_speed": f"Final speed {speed:.12g} m/s is not below {world.max_final_speed_ms:.12g} m/s",
        "completion_within_deadline": f"Completed horizon={completed}, actual end={end:.12g} s, deadline={world.completion_deadline_s:.12g} s",
        "finite_measurements": "Nonfinite state measurements prevent acceptance"}
    return {"status": "PASS" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL",
            "criteria": {"wall_collision_events": 0, "minimum_clearance_m": world.minimum_clearance_m,
                         "max_final_speed_ms_exclusive": world.max_final_speed_ms,
                         "completion_deadline_s": world.completion_deadline_s},
            "checks": {name: "PASS" if passed else "FAIL" for name, passed in checks.items()},
            "wall_collision_events": events, "wall_contact_samples": sum(contact_states),
            "minimum_measured_clearance_m": minimum, "final_speed_ms": speed, "final_time_s": end,
            "failure_reasons": [explanations[name] for name, passed in checks.items() if not passed]}


def independently_verify_safety(run: dict[str, Any], tolerance: float = 1e-12) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Fresh direct stepping, geometry-distance query and contact IDs; no simulator helper.

    Reuses the actual controller under test, never its inferred behavior. Safety
    classification and observations are independent of the main telemetry flags.
    """
    metadata = run["metadata"]
    if metadata["controller"]["name"] != "robot.controller.faulty_braking_controller":
        raise ValueError("Independent Day 2 verifier requires the actual faulty controller")
    effective_xml = run["effective_model_xml"]
    digest = hashlib.sha256(effective_xml.encode()).hexdigest()
    if digest != metadata["effective_mjcf_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Effective MuJoCo model snapshot hash mismatch")
    model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string(effective_xml)
    body = BodyBase.from_dict(metadata["context"]["bodybase"])
    world = WorldBase.from_dict(metadata["context"]["worldbase"])
    cfg = metadata["configuration"]
    model.opt.timestep = cfg["timestep_s"]
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    data.joint("x_slide").qpos[0] = cfg["initial_position_m"]
    data.joint("x_slide").qvel[0] = cfg["initial_velocity_mps"]
    wall, bumper = model.geom("wall").id, model.geom("front_bumper").id
    trace = []
    for step in range(cfg["steps"] + 1):
        mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
        faulty_braking_controller(model, data)
        mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
        contacts = [{"geom_ids": [int(c.geom1), int(c.geom2)],
                     "geom_names": [model.geom(int(c.geom1)).name, model.geom(int(c.geom2)).name],
                     "distance_m": float(c.dist)} for c in data.contact[:data.ncon]]
        wall_contacts = [c for c in contacts if wall in c["geom_ids"]]
        trace.append({"step": step, "time": float(data.time), "position": float(data.qpos[0]),
                      "velocity": float(data.qvel[0]), "control": float(data.ctrl[0]),
                      "generalized_actuator_force": float(data.qfrc_actuator[0]),
                      "wall_clearance": float(mujoco.mj_geomDistance(
                          model, data, bumper, wall,
                          math.dist(data.geom_xpos[bumper], data.geom_xpos[wall])
                          + sum(model.geom_size[bumper]) + sum(model.geom_size[wall]) + 1, None)),
                      "wall_contacts": wall_contacts, "contacts": contacts})
        if step < cfg["steps"]:
            mujoco.mj_step(model, data)
    measured = run["telemetry"]
    same_length = len(trace) == len(measured)
    fields = ("time", "position", "velocity", "control", "generalized_actuator_force", "wall_clearance")
    differences = {field: max(abs(a[field] - b[field]) for a, b in zip(trace, measured)) for field in fields}
    consistent = same_length and max(differences.values()) <= tolerance
    # Match actual IDs, rather than trusting the main run's wall_collision boolean.
    contact_ids_match = same_length and all([c["geom_ids"] for c in a["contacts"]]
                                           == [c["geom_ids"] for c in b["contacts"]]
                                           for a, b in zip(trace, measured))
    events = [s for s in trace if s["wall_contacts"]]
    minimum = min(s["wall_clearance"] for s in trace)
    desired = cfg["desired_future_clearance_m"]
    no_contact = not events
    clearance_ok = minimum >= desired
    finite = all(math.isfinite(s[f]) for s in trace for f in fields)
    acceptance = evaluate_safety(trace, world, wall)
    params = physical_parameters(model)
    context_matches = (params["mass_kg"] == body.mass_kg and params["max_braking_force_n"] == body.max_force_n
                       and model.body("obstacle").pos[0] == world.wall_position_x_m
                       and model.opt.timestep == world.simulation_timestep_s
                       and cfg["initial_velocity_mps"] == world.initial_velocity_ms
                       and cfg["initial_position_m"] == world.initial_position_x_m)
    legacy_task = "PASS" if no_contact and clearance_ok and finite else "FAIL"
    task = acceptance["status"] if metadata["safety_policy"] == "stop_before_wall" else legacy_task
    return {"method": "Fresh MjModel/MjData; direct mj_step; wall geom IDs and mj_geomDistance",
            "model_sha256": sha256(Path(metadata["model_path"])),
            "effective_mjcf_sha256": digest, "effective_context_matches": context_matches,
            "trace": trace, "samples": len(trace), "absolute_tolerance": tolerance,
            "max_abs_telemetry_differences": differences,
            "telemetry_matches": consistent and contact_ids_match,
            "contact_ids_match": contact_ids_match, "finite_state": finite,
            "wall_contact_samples": len(events), "first_wall_contact": events[0] if events else None,
            "minimum_clearance_m": minimum, "desired_clearance_m": desired,
            "collision_free": no_contact, "desired_clearance_satisfied": clearance_ok,
            "task": metadata["safety_policy"], "safety_acceptance": acceptance,
            "physical_safety_task": task,
            "verification_execution": "PASS" if consistent and contact_ids_match and finite and context_matches else "FAIL"}


def failure_diagnostics(run: dict[str, Any], independent: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    samples, metadata = run["telemetry"], run["metadata"]
    model = run["model"]
    params = physical_parameters(model)
    wall_id = model.geom("wall").id
    braking = next((s for s in samples if s["velocity"] > 0 and s["generalized_actuator_force"] < 0), None)
    contacts = [s for s in samples if any(wall_id in c["geom_ids"] for c in s["contacts"])]
    first = contacts[0] if contacts else None
    prediction = stopping_prediction(params["mass_kg"], params["max_braking_force_n"],
                                     samples[0]["velocity"], BRAKING_THRESHOLD_M)
    at_braking = (stopping_prediction(params["mass_kg"], params["max_braking_force_n"],
                                     braking["velocity"], braking["wall_clearance"]) if braking else None)
    cfg = metadata["configuration"]
    finite = all(math.isfinite(s[f]) for s in samples for f in ("position", "velocity", "time"))
    execution_ok = len(samples) == cfg["steps"] + 1 and math.isclose(samples[-1]["time"], cfg["duration_s"], abs_tol=1e-12)
    simulation_ok = execution_ok and finite and not metadata["warnings"]
    unexpected = [c for s in samples for c in s["contacts"]
                  if set(c["geom_ids"]) != {model.geom("front_bumper").id, wall_id}]
    minimum = min(s["wall_clearance"] for s in samples)
    task_pass = not contacts and minimum >= cfg["desired_future_clearance_m"]
    world = WorldBase.from_dict(metadata["context"]["worldbase"])
    acceptance = evaluate_safety(samples, world, wall_id)
    if metadata["safety_policy"] == "stop_before_wall":
        task_pass = acceptance["status"] == "PASS"
    verified = independent["verification_execution"] == "PASS" and independent["telemetry_matches"]
    reproduced = (simulation_ok and verified and braking is not None and first is not None
                  and first["velocity"] > 0 and not task_pass and not unexpected
                  and not at_braking["stop_before_wall_predicted"])
    if braking is None:
        explanation = "No braking onset was observed in the executed trajectory."
    elif first is None:
        explanation = (f"Braking began with {braking['wall_clearance']:.6g} m clearance at "
                       f"{braking['velocity']:.6g} m/s; no wall contact was observed.")
    else:
        explanation = (f"The fixed {BRAKING_THRESHOLD_M:g} m rule began braking at {braking['time']:.6g} s, "
                       f"with {braking['wall_clearance']:.6g} m clearance and {braking['velocity']:.6g} m/s velocity. "
                       f"At the model's {params['max_braking_force_n']:g} N braking limit and {params['mass_kg']:g} kg mass, "
                       f"continuous-time stopping needs {at_braking['stopping_distance_m']:.6g} m. "
                       f"MuJoCo detected wall contact at {first['time']:.6g} s while velocity was {first['velocity']:.6g} m/s. "
                       "The code executed, but the fixed threshold ignored the required stopping distance.")
    return {"schema_version": 1, "run_id": metadata["run_id"],
            "simulation_configuration": cfg, "source_sha256": metadata["source_sha256"],
            "physical_context": metadata["context"], "effective_mjcf_sha256": metadata["effective_mjcf_sha256"],
            "controller": metadata["controller"], "controller_fixed_threshold_m": BRAKING_THRESHOLD_M,
            "robot_physical_parameters": params, "analytical_prediction": prediction,
            "prediction_at_measured_braking_onset": at_braking,
            "actual_available_braking_distance_m": braking["wall_clearance"] if braking else None,
            "braking_initiation": braking, "first_wall_contact": first,
            "wall_contact_samples": len(contacts),
            "wall_contact_points_summed_over_samples": sum(s["contact_count"] for s in contacts),
            "unintended_contact_points": len(unexpected), "minimum_observed_clearance_m": minimum,
            "final_state": samples[-1], "physical_failure_explanation": explanation,
            "software_execution": "PASS" if execution_ok else "FAIL",
            "physics_simulation": "PASS" if simulation_ok else "FAIL",
            "physical_safety_task": "PASS" if task_pass else "FAIL",
            "safety_policy": metadata["safety_policy"], "safety_acceptance": acceptance,
            "expected_contact_failure_reproduced": reproduced,
            "independent_safety_verification": {k: v for k, v in independent.items() if k != "trace"},
            "contact_timing_note": "First contact is a discrete sampled state before its subsequent contact impulse; it is not a continuous-time impact root.",
            "contact_model_note": "Soft-contact overlap and rebound are measured; positive final clearance does not undo an earlier collision."}

"""One MuJoCo trajectory supplies telemetry and native renders, with optional control."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from contextlib import ExitStack
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from dataclasses import replace
import hashlib
import inspect
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from typing import Any, Callable
from uuid import uuid4
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import mujoco
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

from core.bodybase import BodyBase
from core.worldbase import WorldBase

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH = ROOT / "robot" / "rail_carriage.xml"
DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS_DIR = ROOT / "artifacts" / "day1"
CONFIG_PATH = ROOT / "configs" / "embody_config.json"
# Compatibility view for existing Day 1 callers; not a second configuration.
_default_body, _default_world = BodyBase.from_json(), WorldBase.from_json()
CONFIG = {"robot": {"mass_kg": _default_body.mass_kg, "max_actuator_force_n": _default_body.max_force_n,
                    "initial_velocity_mps": _default_world.initial_velocity_ms},
          "environment": {"initial_position_m": _default_world.initial_position_x_m,
                          "obstacle_position_m": _default_world.wall_position_x_m,
                          "minimum_clearance_m": _default_world.minimum_clearance_m,
                          "timestep_s": _default_world.simulation_timestep_s,
                          "duration_s": _default_world.simulation_duration_s,
                          "gravity_mps2": list(_default_world.gravity_ms2)}}


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def source_hashes(model_path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    paths = [model_path, ROOT / "requirements.txt", ROOT / "pytest.ini"]
    paths += sorted((ROOT / "configs").glob("*.json"))
    paths += sorted((ROOT / "core").rglob("*.py"))
    paths += sorted((ROOT / "tests").glob("test_*.py"))
    paths += sorted((ROOT / "robot").glob("*.py"))
    return {str(p.relative_to(ROOT) if p.is_relative_to(ROOT) else p): sha256(p) for p in paths}


def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def _contact_details(model: mujoco.MjModel, data: mujoco.MjData) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    details = []
    for idx in range(data.ncon):
        contact = data.contact[idx]
        force = np.zeros(6)
        mujoco.mj_contactForce(model, data, idx, force)
        names = [mujoco.mj_id2name(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM, int(g))
                 for g in (contact.geom1, contact.geom2)]
        details.append({"geom_ids": [int(contact.geom1), int(contact.geom2)],
                        "geom_1": names[0], "geom_2": names[1],
                        "dist": float(contact.dist), "normal_force_n": float(force[0]),
                        "involves_wall": "wall" in names})
    return details


def collision_surfaces(model: mujoco.MjModel, data: mujoco.MjData) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Signed axial surface gap; exact for this model's aligned, overlapping boxes."""
    bumper, wall = model.geom("front_bumper").id, model.geom("wall").id
    bumper_extent = float(np.abs(data.geom_xmat[bumper].reshape(3, 3)[0]) @ model.geom_size[bumper])
    wall_extent = float(np.abs(data.geom_xmat[wall].reshape(3, 3)[0]) @ model.geom_size[wall])
    front = float(data.geom_xpos[bumper, 0]) + bumper_extent
    near = float(data.geom_xpos[wall, 0]) - wall_extent
    return {"bumper_front_x": front, "wall_near_x": near, "wall_clearance": near - front}


def compile_context_model(model_path: str | Path, bodybase: BodyBase,
                          worldbase: WorldBase) -> tuple[mujoco.MjModel, str]:
    """Apply authoritative context to a fresh MJCF tree, then compile real physics."""
    if abs(worldbase.initial_velocity_ms) > bodybase.max_velocity_ms + 1e-12:
        raise ValueError("Initial speed exceeds BODYBASE's nominal initial-speed envelope")
    root = ET.parse(model_path).getroot()
    bodybase.apply_to_xml(root)
    worldbase.apply_to_xml(root)
    xml = ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string(xml)
    if (model.nq, model.nv, model.njnt, model.nu) != (1, 1, 1, 1):
        raise ValueError("This foundation requires exactly one joint, DOF and actuator")
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    data.qpos[0] = worldbase.initial_position_x_m
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
    if collision_surfaces(model, data)["wall_clearance"] <= 0 or data.ncon:
        raise ValueError("Initial geometry must have positive wall clearance and no unintended contacts")
    bumper, wall = model.geom("front_bumper").id, model.geom("wall").id
    for axis in (1, 2):
        if abs(data.geom_xpos[bumper, axis] - data.geom_xpos[wall, axis]) >= model.geom_size[bumper, axis] + model.geom_size[wall, axis]:
            raise ValueError("Wall and bumper must overlap in y/z for this one-axis clearance model")
    return model, xml


def _capture(renderer: mujoco.Renderer, model: mujoco.MjModel, data: mujoco.MjData,
             sample: dict[str, Any], stage: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    renderer.update_scene(data, camera="demo_camera")
    pixels = renderer.render().copy()
    if pixels.shape != (768, 1024, 3) or float(pixels.std()) < 5:
        raise RuntimeError("Native MuJoCo render is empty, uniform or has incorrect dimensions")
    # A native segmentation pass verifies that the required geoms are visible,
    # rather than treating PNG creation or pixel variation as scene verification.
    renderer.enable_segmentation_rendering()
    try:
        segmentation = renderer.render()
        counts = {}
        for name in ("carriage_box", "front_bumper", "rail_track", "wall"):
            counts[name] = int(np.count_nonzero(
                (segmentation[:, :, 0] == model.geom(name).id)
                & (segmentation[:, :, 1] == int(mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM))))
        if min(counts.values()) == 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Required scene geometry is not visible: {counts}")
    finally:
        renderer.disable_segmentation_rendering()
    relative = Path("render_frames") / f"frame_{sample['step']:04d}.png"
    path = stage / relative
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    Image.fromarray(pixels).save(path)
    return {"path": str(relative), "step": sample["step"], "time": float(data.time),
            "position": float(data.qpos[0]), "velocity": float(data.qvel[0]),
            "sha256": sha256(path), "dimensions": [1024, 768],
            "pixel_std": float(pixels.std()), "visible_geom_pixels": counts,
            "bumper_front_x": sample["bumper_front_x"],
            "control": sample["control"], "wall_collision": sample["wall_collision"],
            "wall_clearance": sample["wall_clearance"]}


def run_simulation(
    model_path: str | Path = DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH,
    duration: float | None = None,
    dt: float | None = None,
    initial_velocity: float | None = None,
    save_telemetry: bool = True,
    save_render: bool = True,
    artifacts_dir: str | Path = DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS_DIR,
    initial_position: float | None = None,
    control: float = 0.0,
    controller: Callable[[mujoco.MjModel, mujoco.MjData], None] | None = None,
    render_interval_steps: int | None = None,
    bodybase: BodyBase | None = None,
    worldbase: WorldBase | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    explicit_context = bodybase is not None or worldbase is not None
    bodybase = bodybase if bodybase is not None else BodyBase.from_json()
    worldbase = worldbase if worldbase is not None else WorldBase.from_json()
    if not isinstance(bodybase, BodyBase) or not isinstance(worldbase, WorldBase):
        raise ValueError("Pass validated BodyBase and WorldBase instances")
    overrides = {name: value for name, value in {"simulation_duration_s": duration, "simulation_timestep_s": dt,
                                               "initial_velocity_ms": initial_velocity, "initial_position_x_m": initial_position}.items()
                 if value is not None}
    worldbase = replace(worldbase, **overrides)
    duration, dt = worldbase.simulation_duration_s, worldbase.simulation_timestep_s
    initial_velocity, initial_position = worldbase.initial_velocity_ms, worldbase.initial_position_x_m
    if controller is not None and control != 0:
        raise ValueError("Choose either a controller or a constant control command")
    if render_interval_steps is not None and (isinstance(render_interval_steps, bool)
                                              or not isinstance(render_interval_steps, int)
                                              or render_interval_steps <= 0):
        raise ValueError("render_interval_steps must be a positive integer")
    for name, value in {"duration": duration, "dt": dt, "initial_velocity": initial_velocity,
                        "initial_position": initial_position, "control": control}.items():
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
    if dt <= 0 or duration < 0:
        raise ValueError("dt must be positive and duration nonnegative")
    steps = round(duration / dt)
    if not math.isclose(steps * dt, duration, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-10):
        raise ValueError("duration must be an integer multiple of dt")
    model_path = Path(model_path).resolve()
    model, effective_xml = compile_context_model(model_path, bodybase, worldbase)
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    data.qpos[model.joint("x_slide").qposadr[0]] = initial_position
    data.qvel[model.joint("x_slide").dofadr[0]] = initial_velocity
    data.ctrl[model.actuator("x_motor").id] = control
    telemetry: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    frames: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    output = Path(artifacts_dir).resolve()
    if (controller is not None or explicit_context) and (save_telemetry or save_render) and output == DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS_DIR.resolve():
        raise ValueError("Controller runs require a separate artifacts_dir to preserve Day 1 evidence")
    metadata = {
        "schema_version": 1, "run_id": str(uuid4()),
        "created_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "python_version": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform(),
        "mujoco_version": mujoco.__version__, "numpy_version": np.__version__,
        "source_sha256": source_hashes(model_path), "model_path": str(model_path),
        "effective_mjcf_sha256": hashlib.sha256(effective_xml.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "context": {"bodybase": bodybase.to_dict(), "worldbase": worldbase.to_dict()},
        "safety_policy": "stop_before_wall" if explicit_context else "day2_compatibility",
        "configuration": {"duration_s": duration, "timestep_s": dt, "steps": steps,

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

    parser.add_argument("--no-render", action="store_true", help="Explicit physics-only run; no image claims")

"""Intentionally unsafe Day 2 baseline; no dynamic stopping-distance controller."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

import mujoco

from core.simulation import collision_surfaces

BRAKING_THRESHOLD_M = 0.12


def faulty_braking_controller(model: mujoco.MjModel, data: mujoco.MjData) -> None:
    """Brake at a fixed surface gap, ignoring mass, speed and stopping distance.

    The simulator refreshes derived geometry before this call. The velocity guard
    releases braking after stopping/rebound; it does not repair the late trigger.
    """
    joint = data.joint("x_slide")
    position, velocity = float(joint.qpos[0]), float(joint.qvel[0])
    if not math.isfinite(position) or not math.isfinite(velocity):
        raise ValueError("Controller requires finite joint position and velocity")
    clearance = collision_surfaces(model, data)["wall_clearance"]
    motor = model.actuator("x_motor").id
    # This scene has a direct motor (gear=1); both compiled clamps are in N.
    maximum_braking_command = max(float(model.actuator_ctrlrange[motor, 0]),
                                  float(model.actuator_forcerange[motor, 0]))
    # INTENTIONAL DEFECT: 0.12 m is treated as enough at every forward speed.
    # Treat floating-point roundoff at the threshold as equality (1 picometer).
    threshold_reached = clearance <= BRAKING_THRESHOLD_M or math.isclose(
        clearance, BRAKING_THRESHOLD_M, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-12)
    data.ctrl[motor] = maximum_braking_command if threshold_reached and velocity > 0 else 0.0

I inspected the actual controller, robot model, and all three authoritative scenarios, then ran and verified simulations.

### Cause
The collision is caused by the controller’s fixed braking trigger:

- `robot/controller.py` brakes only when `wall_clearance <= 0.12 m`
- It ignores:
  - robot mass
  - current speed
  - actuator braking authority
  - required safety clearance
  - discrete-time reaction effects

### Evidence
Baseline controller failed in all scenarios:

- **A**: brakes at `0.12 m`, but physics predicts it needs about **0.36 m** to stop from `1.2 m/s` with `2.0 kg` and `4 N` braking.  
  Result: wall contact at `0.97 m/s`.
- **B**: heavier robot (`3.0 kg`) needs about **0.54 m** to stop.  
  Result: wall contact at `1.05 m/s`.
- **C**: changed wall location and initial speed; still needs about **0.25 m** to stop.  
  Result: wall contact at `0.71 m/s`.

Those are measured simulation results, independently verified.

### Repair proposed
I submitted a controller-only patch that:

- computes braking onset from **measured stopping distance**
- uses actual:
  - carriage mass
  - actuator force limits
  - timestep
  - current velocity
- includes a **reaction buffer**
- keeps braking latched near the wall so it doesn’t release too early
- actively damps residual reverse motion so final speed settles below the limit

### Verification result
The second proposal was independently executed and **passed A/B/C**:

- **Candidate:** `candidate_9ba053aaee684edf8f1914731a5449fc`

Measured outcomes:

- **A**: min clearance `0.0524 m`, final speed ~`0`
- **B**: min clearance `0.05237 m`, final speed ~`0`
- **C**: min clearance `0.05255 m`, final speed ~`0`

All passed:
- zero wall contact events
- minimum clearance ≥ `0.05 m`
- final speed < `0.03 m/s`

### Concise diagnosis
The wall collision was not a MuJoCo or geometry issue; it was a controller design defect. A fixed `0.12 m` trigger is too late and does not generalize across masses or environments. A stopping-distance-based controller fixes that and was independently verified across the provided robot/world variants.

"""Stopping-distance-aware wall-braking controller."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

import mujoco

from core.simulation import collision_surfaces

MIN_CLEARANCE_M = 0.05
TARGET_FINAL_SPEED_MPS = 0.02
HOLDING_EXTRA_CLEARANCE_M = 0.10


def faulty_braking_controller(model: mujoco.MjModel, data: mujoco.MjData) -> None:
    """Brake using measured stopping distance and keep braking until motion settles."""
    joint = data.joint("x_slide")
    position = float(joint.qpos[0])
    velocity = float(joint.qvel[0])
    if not math.isfinite(position) or not math.isfinite(velocity):
        raise ValueError("Controller requires finite joint position and velocity")

    motor = model.actuator("x_motor").id
    ctrl_min = float(model.actuator_ctrlrange[motor, 0])
    force_min = float(model.actuator_forcerange[motor, 0])
    maximum_braking_command = min(ctrl_min, force_min)
    braking_force_n = -maximum_braking_command
    mass_kg = float(model.body("carriage").mass[0])
    timestep_s = float(model.opt.timestep)
    clearance = collision_surfaces(model, data)["wall_clearance"]

    command = 0.0
    if (math.isfinite(clearance) and math.isfinite(braking_force_n) and math.isfinite(mass_kg)
            and math.isfinite(timestep_s) and braking_force_n > 0.0 and mass_kg > 0.0 and timestep_s > 0.0):
        max_deceleration = braking_force_n / mass_kg
        speed = abs(velocity)
        reaction_buffer = speed * timestep_s + 0.5 * max_deceleration * timestep_s * timestep_s
        stop_distance = speed * speed / (2.0 * max_deceleration)
        trigger_clearance = MIN_CLEARANCE_M + max(HOLDING_EXTRA_CLEARANCE_M, stop_distance + reaction_buffer)
        if velocity < -TARGET_FINAL_SPEED_MPS:
            command = -maximum_braking_command
        elif velocity > 0.0 and (clearance <= trigger_clearance or math.isclose(clearance, trigger_clearance, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-12)):
            command = maximum_braking_command

    data.ctrl[motor] = command

        raise ValueError("Initial speed exceeds BODYBASE's nominal initial-speed envelope")
    root = ET.parse(model_path).getroot()
    bodybase.apply_to_xml(root)
    worldbase.apply_to_xml(root)

    if (model.nq, model.nv, model.njnt, model.nu) != (1, 1, 1, 1):
        raise ValueError("This foundation requires exactly one joint, DOF and actuator")

    data.qpos[0] = worldbase.initial_position_x_m

             sample: dict[str, Any], stage: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    renderer.update_scene(data, camera="demo_camera")
    pixels = renderer.render().copy()
    if pixels.shape != (768, 1024, 3) or float(pixels.std()) < 5:
        raise RuntimeError("Native MuJoCo render is empty, uniform or has incorrect dimensions")
    # A native segmentation pass verifies that the required geoms are visible,
    # rather than treating PNG creation or pixel variation as scene verification.
    renderer.enable_segmentation_rendering()
    try:
        segmentation = renderer.render()
        counts = {}
        for name in ("carriage_box", "front_bumper", "rail_track", "wall"):
            counts[name] = int(np.count_nonzero(
                (segmentation[:, :, 0] == model.geom(name).id)
                & (segmentation[:, :, 1] == int(mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM))))

    path = stage / relative

            "position": float(data.qpos[0]), "velocity": float(data.qvel[0]),

def run_simulation(
    model_path: str | Path = DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH,
    duration: float | None = None,
    dt: float | None = None,
    initial_velocity: float | None = None,
    save_telemetry: bool = True,
    save_render: bool = True,
    artifacts_dir: str | Path = DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS_DIR,
    initial_position: float | None = None,
    control: float = 0.0,
    controller: Callable[[mujoco.MjModel, mujoco.MjData], None] | None = None,
    render_interval_steps: int | None = None,
    bodybase: BodyBase | None = None,
    worldbase: WorldBase | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    explicit_context = bodybase is not None or worldbase is not None
    bodybase = bodybase if bodybase is not None else BodyBase.from_json()
    worldbase = worldbase if worldbase is not None else WorldBase.from_json()
    if not isinstance(bodybase, BodyBase) or not isinstance(worldbase, WorldBase):
        raise ValueError("Pass validated BodyBase and WorldBase instances")
    overrides = {name: value for name, value in {"simulation_duration_s": duration, "simulation_timestep_s": dt,
                                               "initial_velocity_ms": initial_velocity, "initial_position_x_m": initial_position}.items()
                 if value is not None}
    worldbase = replace(worldbase, **overrides)
    duration, dt = worldbase.simulation_duration_s, worldbase.simulation_timestep_s
    initial_velocity, initial_position = worldbase.initial_velocity_ms, worldbase.initial_position_x_m
    if controller is not None and control != 0:
        raise ValueError("Choose either a controller or a constant control command")
    if render_interval_steps is not None and (isinstance(render_interval_steps, bool)
                                              or not isinstance(render_interval_steps, int)
                                              or render_interval_steps <= 0):
        raise ValueError("render_interval_steps must be a positive integer")
    for name, value in {"duration": duration, "dt": dt, "initial_velocity": initial_velocity,
                        "initial_position": initial_position, "control": control}.items():
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
    if dt <= 0 or duration < 0:
        raise ValueError("dt must be positive and duration nonnegative")
    steps = round(duration / dt)
    if not math.isclose(steps * dt, duration, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-10):
        raise ValueError("duration must be an integer multiple of dt")
    model_path = Path(model_path).resolve()
    model, effective_xml = compile_context_model(model_path, bodybase, worldbase)
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    data.qpos[model.joint("x_slide").qposadr[0]] = initial_position
    data.qvel[model.joint("x_slide").dofadr[0]] = initial_velocity
    data.ctrl[model.actuator("x_motor").id] = control
    telemetry: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    frames: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    output = Path(artifacts_dir).resolve()
    if (controller is not None or explicit_context) and (save_telemetry or save_render) and output == DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS_DIR.resolve():
        raise ValueError("Controller runs require a separate artifacts_dir to preserve Day 1 evidence")
    metadata = {
        "schema_version": 1, "run_id": str(uuid4()),
        "created_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "python_version": sys.version, "platform": platform.platform(),
        "mujoco_version": mujoco.__version__, "numpy_version": np.__version__,
        "source_sha256": source_hashes(model_path), "model_path": str(model_path),
        "effective_mjcf_sha256": hashlib.sha256(effective_xml.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "context": {"bodybase": bodybase.to_dict(), "worldbase": worldbase.to_dict()},
        "safety_policy": "stop_before_wall" if explicit_context else "day2_compatibility",
        "configuration": {"duration_s": duration, "timestep_s": dt, "steps": steps,
                          "initial_position_m": initial_position, "initial_velocity_mps": initial_velocity,
                          "control_input_n": control, "gravity_mps2": model.opt.gravity.tolist(),
                          "desired_future_clearance_m": worldbase.minimum_clearance_m},
        "model": {"carriage_mass_kg": float(model.body("carriage").mass[0]),
                  "ctrlrange": model.actuator_ctrlrange[0].tolist(),
                  "scalar_forcerange_n": model.actuator_forcerange[0].tolist(),
                  "gear": float(model.actuator_gear[0, 0]),
                  "rail_size": model.geom("rail_track").size.tolist(),
                  "wall_center_m": model.body("obstacle").pos.tolist(),
                  "wall_half_size_m": model.geom("wall").size.tolist()},
        "geometry_convention": "wall_position_x_m is the wall center; clearance is the signed wall-near-face minus bumper-front surface gap derived from effective geometry; negative means penetration",
        "sampling": "Initial state and every completed step; mj_forward refreshes derived state before sampling and rendering",
        "rendering": {"status": "native" if save_render else "not_requested",
                      "backend": "mujoco.Renderer", "camera": "demo_camera", "frames": frames,
                      "interval_steps": render_interval_steps},
        "units": {"time": "s", "position": "m", "velocity": "m/s", "acceleration": "m/s^2",
                  "control": "N (direct motor, gear=1)", "scalar_actuator_force": "N",
                  "generalized_actuator_force": "N", "wall_clearance": "m"},
    }
    if controller is not None:
        controller_path = Path(inspect.getsourcefile(controller)).resolve()
        metadata["controller"] = {"name": f"{controller.__module__}.{controller.__qualname__}",
                                  "source_path": str(controller_path.relative_to(ROOT)
                                                     if controller_path.is_relative_to(ROOT) else controller_path),
                                  "source_sha256": sha256(controller_path),
                                  "function_sha256": hashlib.sha256(inspect.getsource(controller).encode()).hexdigest()}
        metadata["configuration"]["control_mode"] = "controller"
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        stage = None
        if save_telemetry or save_render:
            output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            temp = stack.enter_context(tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".simulation-", dir=output.parent))
            stage = Path(temp) / "run"
            stage.mkdir()
        renderer = None
        if save_render:
            # Fail visibly on native renderer errors. There is no drawing fallback.
            renderer = stack.enter_context(mujoco.Renderer(model, height=768, width=1024))
        frame_steps = {0, round(steps / 3), round(2 * steps / 3), steps}
        if render_interval_steps is not None:
            frame_steps.update(range(0, steps + 1, render_interval_steps))
        braking_seen = wall_contact_seen = False
        for step in range(steps + 1):
            # mj_step integrates qpos/qvel, but derived contacts and geom transforms
            # otherwise describe the preceding state. Refresh without integrating.
            mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
            if controller is not None:
                controller(model, data)
                if not np.isfinite(data.ctrl).all():
                    raise ValueError("Controller produced a nonfinite actuator command")
                mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
            contacts = _contact_details(model, data)
            sample = {"step": step, "time": float(data.time), "position": float(data.qpos[0]),
                      "velocity": float(data.qvel[0]), "acceleration": float(data.qacc[0]),
                      "control": float(data.ctrl[0]),
                      "scalar_actuator_force": float(data.actuator_force[0]),
                      "generalized_actuator_force": float(data.qfrc_actuator[0]),
                      "carriage_center_x": float(data.xpos[model.body("carriage").id, 0]),
                      **collision_surfaces(model, data),
                      "wall_collision": any(c["involves_wall"] for c in contacts),
                      "contact_count": len(contacts), "contacts": contacts}
            telemetry.append(sample)
            braking_now = sample["velocity"] > 0 and sample["generalized_actuator_force"] < 0
            event_frame = controller is not None and ((braking_now and not braking_seen)
                                                      or (sample["wall_collision"] and not wall_contact_seen))
            if renderer is not None and (step in frame_steps or event_frame):
                frames.append(_capture(renderer, model, data, sample, stage))
            braking_seen |= braking_now
            wall_contact_seen |= sample["wall_collision"]
            if step < steps:
                mujoco.mj_step(model, data)
        metadata["actual_steps"] = steps
        metadata["actual_samples"] = len(telemetry)
        metadata["final_simulation_time_s"] = float(data.time)
        metadata["warnings"] = {mujoco.mjtWarning(i).name: int(w.number)
                                for i, w in enumerate(data.warning) if w.number}
        if frames:
            # Representative image is the actual t=1 s frame for the default run.
            representative = frames[min(1, len(frames) - 1)]
            shutil.copyfile(stage / representative["path"], stage / "render.png")
            metadata["rendering"]["representative_frame"] = representative["path"]
        if save_telemetry:
            write_json(stage / "telemetry.json", {"metadata": metadata, "samples": telemetry})
        if stage is not None:
            (stage / "effective_model.xml").write_text(effective_xml)
            write_json(stage / "manifest.json", metadata)
            # Publish only after the complete run succeeds. Preserve every prior
            # output (including unrelated files) in an archive rather than mixing it.
            if output.exists():
                if any(output.iterdir()):
                    archive = output.parent / "archive"
                    archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                    output.rename(archive / f"{output.name}-{metadata['run_id']}")
                else:
                    output.rmdir()
            stage.rename(output)
    return {"model": model, "data": data, "telemetry": telemetry, "metadata": metadata,
            "effective_model_xml": effective_xml, "bodybase": bodybase, "worldbase": worldbase,
            "position_history": [s["position"] for s in telemetry],
            "velocity_history": [s["velocity"] for s in telemetry],
            "time_history": [s["time"] for s in telemetry],
            "contact_history": [s["contacts"] for s in telemetry],
            "render_path": output / "render.png" if frames else None,
            "render_frames": [output / f["path"] for f in frames], "artifacts_dir": output}


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--artifacts-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_ARTIFACTS_DIR)
    parser.add_argument("--no-render", action="store_true", help="Explicit physics-only run; no image claims")
    parser.add_argument("--control", type=float, default=0, help="Constant force command in N")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = run_simulation(artifacts_dir=args.artifacts_dir, save_render=not args.no_render, control=args.control)
    print(json.dumps({"artifacts_dir": str(result["artifacts_dir"]),
                      "steps": result["metadata"]["actual_steps"], "samples": len(result["telemetry"]),
                      "final_state": result["telemetry"][-1],
                      "rendering": result["metadata"]["rendering"]["status"]}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    """Brake using measured stopping distance and keep braking until motion settles."""
    joint = data.joint("x_slide")
    position = float(joint.qpos[0])
    velocity = float(joint.qvel[0])
    if not math.isfinite(position) or not math.isfinite(velocity):

    ctrl_min = float(model.actuator_ctrlrange[motor, 0])
    force_min = float(model.actuator_forcerange[motor, 0])
    maximum_braking_command = min(ctrl_min, force_min)
    braking_force_n = -maximum_braking_command
    mass_kg = float(model.body("carriage").mass[0])
    timestep_s = float(model.opt.timestep)
    clearance = collision_surfaces(model, data)["wall_clearance"]

    if (math.isfinite(clearance) and math.isfinite(braking_force_n) and math.isfinite(mass_kg)
